Station infrastructure curves through the mid-ground in a vast arc, pressurized habitat rings rotating at one revolution per minute, docking arm clusters extending outward like fingers, each tip lit with a red navigation beacon.

A supply drone convoy of twelve units moves in single-file formation between the featured ship and the station ring, each drone carrying a standardized cargo module strapped beneath its body, their formation lights blinking in coordinated green sequence.

Two escort fighters cross in tight formation through the foreground at high speed, their engine bells glowing molten-orange, canopy running lights leaving brief white streaks that fade before the eye can fully track them.
A cluster of eight EVA workers anchored to a buckled hull plate, their white suits strobing with chest-mounted work lights as plasma cutters trace orange arcs across the breach seam.

Three refueling tenders locked in echelon formation off the port quarter, their umbilical booms extended and glowing amber at the coupling collars, fuel transfer status lights cycling green along the hose lengths.
A magnetic dock grapple array along the lower hull firing in sequence, each claw throwing a blue-white spark as it bites ferrous plating, the locking pistons venting small white nitrogen clouds.

Forty meters above the dorsal spine, a temporary repair scaffold of yellow carbon-tube framing sags slightly under the weight of welding rigs, each rig throwing sustained violet sparks that drift in slow arcs before dying.

A drone swarm of perhaps sixty survey units orbits the mid-section in a loose double helix, each drone a blinking amber pinpoint, their formation compressing and expanding as the swarm algorithms negotiate spacing.

A supply ship running parallel two hundred meters to starboard with its cargo bay doors fully open, six robotic loaders visible inside under harsh fluorescent work lighting, a container pod mid-transfer tumbling slowly on its transit rail.

Two sensor buoys station-keeping five hundred meters out on the bow quarter, their rotating dish arrays catching sunlight in rhythmic flashes, tether lights pulsing red-red-green in navigational sequence.
